Executing read-only SQL: "SELECT company, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) AS emissions_2025, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) AS emissions_2024, 
       (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) * 100 AS percentage_reduction

WHERE sector = 'Technology' 
GROUP BY company

       (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN scope1_emissions + scope2_emissions END) * 100 AS percentage_reduction 
FROM reports 
WHERE sector = 'Technology' 
GROUP BY company 
HAVING emissions_2025 < emissions_2024 
ORDER BY percentage_reduction DESC;
